title: Eating & Drinking in Vietnam
paragraphs: The cost of eating & drinking in VietnamTo help you decide on the amount of spending money to budget for, we have outlined below the approximate cost of meals & drinks in Vietnam.

• Cost of lunch in a local restaurant: £3 excluding drinks• Cost of dinner in a 4 star hotel: £20 excluding drinks• Cost of a local beer: Beer Hanoi, Saigon Beer, 330ml £1- £2• Cost of a bottle of wine: Standard Australian £15
